Three lanes: basic inputs 1–2, scientific 3–4, atomic 5–7.

blocks.text: A recipe is selected from the family supported by the current device. A Scientific recipe does not become a Basic recipe because both devices have two slots. Item components, required counts and research can also distinguish apparently similar ingredients.

Portable operations are immediate and return their container contents safely when closed. A time field in their recipe data does not create a hidden processing timer. Placed processors use their program time and server overrides.
